hook: We gave 5 different AI models one job: design a bridge strong enough to actually hold weight.
caption:
We gave 5 AI models the same job: build a bridge that holds 🌉

Claude, Kimi, Meta, OpenAI and Grok each got the same brief: design, engineer and 3D print a bridge that spans 2 feet on under 500g of filament. Same prompt, five completely different structures.

Then we loaded every one of them with real weight to see which one actually survives.

Send this to the friend who thinks every AI model is basically the same 👇 Which one do you think held up?
